L’ISEE misura la situazione economica de: The ISEE measures a household's economic situation and is needed to access a great many benefits: the single allowance, social bonuses, nursery and canteen fees, scholarships and housing lists. You get it by submitting the DSU (single substitute declaration) through INPS, a CAF or a patronato; much of the data is now pre-filled. The certificate is valid within its reference year and must be renewed: an expired ISEE can block bonus payments. Required documents and deadlines can change: check the official source or ask a CAF/patronato.
Dal 3 agosto 2026 le carte d’identità in: From 3 August 2026 paper identity cards stop being valid across the European Union, even if the document shows a later expiry date. From that day they are no longer good for identifying yourself in Italy or for travelling abroad. If you still have the paper document you must ask your municipality for the Electronic Identity Card (CIE), which can be requested at any time: you book an appointment at the registry office, you need a passport photo, the old document and your tax code, and the CIE arrives by post within a few days. Book early: close to the deadline, council appointments run out. The CIE also works as a digital identity for logging into public websites.
Lo SPID non si spegne: AgID ha rinnovato: SPID is not being switched off: AgID has renewed its agreements with the digital identity providers until 2027. The picture is changing, though: some private providers have introduced an annual renewal fee, while the State is moving services onto the CIE (the electronic identity card, which works as a free digital identity) and onto IT-Wallet, the document wallet inside the IO app. If your SPID provider asks you to pay, you have two free alternatives: move your SPID to another provider, or activate the CIE with the PIN you received at the council. With just one of these identities you can log into INPS, the Revenue Agency, the Immigration Portal and your municipality's services.
Il rinnovo del permesso di soggiorno non: A residence permit renewal is not filed on the day it expires: the application must be sent earlier, as a rule at least 60 days before for two-year permits. You use the "yellow kit" at authorised Poste Italiane counters; the registered-post receipt counts as proof of lawful stay while the application is being processed, and with that number you follow the status online in the foreigners' section of the Polizia di Stato website. Get income, employment contract, accommodation, revenue stamp and a valid passport ready in advance: these are the documents that waste the most time. Since 2026 the Questure have adopted digital handling, which shortens appointment times, but the documents are the same.
L’attestazione ISEE vale fino al 31 dice: The ISEE certificate is valid until 31 December of the year you request it: from 1 January a new DSU (single substitute declaration) is needed. This is not a formality: without an up-to-date ISEE the single allowance automatically drops to the minimum and social bonuses, reduced nursery and canteen fees, scholarships and housing lists all stay blocked. The DSU is filed free of charge through a CAF or a patronato, or online on the INPS site with SPID or CIE; much of the data is already pre-filled. It is best done in the first weeks of January, when the offices are less crowded: you will need ID documents for everyone in the household, tax codes, the tenancy agreement or mortgage details, and the account balances as at 31 December two years earlier.
Il Decreto Flussi stabilisce quante pers: The Decreto Flussi sets how many people may enter Italy for work (seasonal, non-seasonal and self-employed). Applications (pre-filling and submission forms) go through the Interior Ministry's portal, with opening dates ("click-days") that change every year. It pays to prepare the employer's documents and your SPID credentials in advance. The quotas, the eligible categories and the exact submission days are published in specific decrees: check the figures and deadlines on the official source before applying.
Il permesso di soggiorno va rinnovato pr: The residence permit is renewed by applying close to the expiry date, normally using the "yellow kit" available at authorised Poste Italiane counters; you then get a receipt and a Questura appointment for fingerprinting. The status of your application can be followed online on the Immigration Portal. Keep an eye on the expiry date printed on the permit, prepare income, accommodation and the revenue stamp, and don't leave it to the last day. Timings, costs and required documents can vary by permit type and by Questura: always check the official source.
Dopo aver presentato la domanda di rilas: Once you have applied for the issue or renewal of your permit, you can check online how far the processing has got: you need the number on the registered-post receipt issued by Poste. The check is done in the foreigners' section of the Polizia di Stato website. When the permit is ready you are summoned to the Questura to collect it. Keep the receipt and the slip safe: they are your proof of lawful stay while you wait for the document. The exact procedure can change: check the official source.
L’Assegno Unico e Universale è un contri: The Universal Single Allowance is a monthly INPS payment for each dependent child, from pregnancy up to a certain age (longer for children with disabilities). Many foreign nationals who work and live lawfully in Italy are also entitled to it. You apply once on the INPS site (with SPID/CIE) and it renews automatically, but the amount depends on the ISEE: without a valid, up-to-date ISEE you only get the minimum. Amounts, thresholds and residency requirements are updated periodically: check the exact figures on the official source.
Chi ha percepito redditi da lavoro dipen: People with employment income or similar often file their tax return using form 730, which lets you obtain refunds and deductions (medical expenses, rent, children). The Revenue Agency makes a pre-filled 730 available in your private area (log in with SPID/CIE), which you can accept or amend; alternatively you can go to a CAF or a professional. There are deadlines for filing and for any payments. Dates, thresholds and deductions change every year: check the exact terms on the official source before filing.
La NASpI è l’indennità mensile di disocc: NASpI is the monthly unemployment benefit for people who lose their job involuntarily (dismissal and, in some cases, resignation for just cause). You must have built up the required contributions. The application is made online on the INPS site with SPID/CIE, or through a patronato, and there is a deadline for filing it after the employment ends: past that limit the entitlement is lost. Duration and amount depend on your contribution history. Requirements, deadlines and amounts are updated: check the exact conditions on the official source or with a patronato.
Chi soggiorna regolarmente in Italia ha: People staying lawfully in Italy are in many cases entitled (or required) to register with the National Health Service: it gives access to a family doctor, a paediatrician for your children, treatment and the health card. Registration is done at the ASL counter for your municipality of residence, bringing your residence permit, tax code and proof of residence/address. For some categories registration is free, for others it is voluntary with an annual contribution. The practical rules vary from Region to Region: check the conditions for your case on the official source or at the ASL.
I sostegni per la casa (alloggi di edili: Housing support (public housing and rent contributions) is managed locally: each municipality or region publishes its own calls with residency requirements, ISEE thresholds and ranking lists. The application windows are open only for limited periods and often require SPID and a valid ISEE. To avoid missing the deadlines, check your council's notice board and website regularly, or ask a patronato. Requirements and timings vary from place to place: always check your municipality's official call.
La cittadinanza italiana si può richiede: Italian citizenship can be applied for, among other routes, on the basis of lawful and continuous residence or following marriage to an Italian citizen, provided the requirements are met (often including a level of Italian language knowledge). The application is submitted online on the Interior Ministry's dedicated portal, attaching documents such as criminal record and birth certificates, translated and legalised. Processing can take a long time and the status is followed online. Requirements, the years of residence needed and the documents can change: check the current conditions on the official source.
